name: PM-USP Special Scholarship Scheme for Students of J&K and Ladakh (SSS J&K and Ladakh)
provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India
scheme: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Yojana
domicile_requirement: Domicile of Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh
qualification_requirement: Passed Class 12 from JKBOSE or CBSE affiliated schools located in J&K and Ladakh
lateral_entry_requirement: Diploma in Engineering from Polytechnic Institutes recognized by DTE of J&K and Ladakh
excluded_categories: Students receiving another Central/State/UT Government scholarship
Applicants who did not register online on AICTE Portal
Admission to colleges outside the prescribed AICTE Portal list
eligible_institution_criteria: AICTE-approved institutions with 30% or more courses accredited by NBA
Institutions having more than 80% admission consecutively for the last 5 academic years
Eligible Government institutions for specified courses

special_admission_requirements.integrated_law: CLAT qualification required; National Law Universities only
